description: Guide a traveler through a visible elemental chamber. Tokens change its material form, and each seal admits only its matching form.

metadata.notes: Original maze implementation grounded in TRW-005. Visible token collection changes the traveler's form; form-matching seals, browser movement, server replay, and exported verification share one tile contract.

name: Elemental Wayfarer
natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Guide the traveler to the marked exit. Step on each route token and cross the matching glyph seal. Use the visible direction controls or arrow keys/WASD as shown. Do not use code, scripts, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, page state, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL edits, reload, navigation, extensions, or external applications.
